name: Friends of the Library of Hawaii Volunteer
org: Friends of the Library of Hawaii
what_you_do: Help sort, price and sell donated books and other items. Volunteers also help with the big book sales.
who_can_apply: Volunteers must be 16 or older. The online form also asks you to say you are over 18, so ask the group which rule applies to a 16 or 17 year old.
duration: Not stated. Commitments can be once a day, once a week, or as often as you can come.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page. Book sales are in January and June.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online volunteer form, or print the PDF form and mail it in. Then go to an orientation. Questions: admin@friendsofthelibraryofhawaii.org.
notes: This is the Friends group, not the state library system. The state library page says to contact your local branch to ask how you might participate.
